caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow bowl with a broad rim and a single ornate handle. The handle is intricately designed with symmetrical cut-out patterns, including a central arrow-like motif and looping shapes, rendered in fine detail. The main body of the bowl is plain and smoothly contoured, shaded to suggest a metallic material. To the lower left of the bowl, there is a small side profile sketch, showing the bowl's round body and the flat, extended handle. In the upper right of the image, a separate, enlarged drawing of the handle's decorative pattern is included, highlighting its design features, and it is marked with the letters "P.V.D." near its base. The entire composition is done in pencil or graphite on an off-white background, and the shading emphasizes the three-dimensional form and reflective surface of the bowl. No colors are used other than the natural hues of graphite and paper.
title: Silver Porringer
